culte: 11/10/2026 — Pst Joyce Manfoundou — Le parcours d’un disciple affermi
note: Traductions anglaises de contexte archivées au banc ; montage chronologique, sans nouvelle traduction ni nouveau paiement.

segments.en: I want to finish this teaching if we have time.
And fifthly, it tells us that sin ultimately leads to death.
Amen. The Bible does not tell us that death.
Is an accident of life, that is to say that it just happens like that. That is to say that you just die like that. No, no, no. The Bible tells us.
That death is the consequence of sin.
The wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord. Amen.
Behold. See how God is love.

He's going to… the wages of sin is death. Right away, you're afraid, you think you're going to die. But then, he's going to balance that out. What does he say, what does he say? He balances that out, what does he say?
Elsewhere, he tells you that you have received life.
Amen. And there, he tells you that it's free.
Elsewhere, you are told that you have received life, and you must have a certainty of it, an assurance.
It's in 1 John 5. I had told you that you needed to read 1 John 5 from verse 11 to the end.
It's there that you see that the life of God has been received, and that must be a certainty, and it's there that you see the incompatibility between that life.
